blurb: Sovereign binary distribution — chain-anchored upgrade path that survives DNS / registrar / edge takedown of update.monerousd.org
_purpose: Sovereign binary distribution path. The release pipeline writes per-platform installer manifests + SHA256SUMS into this bundle so existing installs can upgrade WITHOUT depending on update.monerousd.org DNS. Per rule 31 in build-1261/CLAUDE.md, this is auxiliary to the primary electron-updater path, not a replacement.
_replaceWith: scripts/sync-sovereign-installers.sh — pulls latest-mac.yml / latest.yml / latest-linux.yml + installer artefacts from the VPS into this bundle and updates SHA256SUMS
